weekly.time_step: 7-day study weeks, week 0 starts at first randomization study day
weekly.event: at least one opioid-positive urine drug screen finding in the study week
weekly.sample_evidence: uds_temp sample record or any UDS finding; week with no sample evidence is missing
weekly.primary_missing_rule: exclude weeks without a recorded sample
weekly.sensitivity_missing_rule: count weeks without a recorded sample as positive
weekly.minimum_sequence: 12 observed screen weeks, including at least 2 run-in and 8 later weeks

daily.time_step: calendar study day over inclusive min/max TLFB drug-record span
daily.event: TLFB Heroin, Opioid, Methadone, or Buprenorphine category on the day
daily.coverage: inferred continuous daily coverage between first and last TLFB drug-use record
